correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference. Prop.1: |B1^3|=4/3, polar=cube vol 8, product 32/3 correct (first-octant simplex + dual vertices). Symmetrization lemma correct: for symmetric K, K subset Pi subset lam K with Pi translated parallelepiped implies centered Q=(Pi+(-Pi))/2 satisfies K subset Q subset lam K (uses +-x in K and convexity). Operator-norm reduction correct: B1 subset T(Binf) subset lam B1 gives ||T^{-1}||_{1->inf}<=1, ||T||_{inf->1}<=lam; vertex/max-entry formulas correct (convex max over cube at vertices; equality on signed basis vector). Averaging identity (1/8)sum_s|r.s|=max(|r|_1/2,|r|_inf) verified analytically (sign reduction + a>=b>=c case split giving 4a vs 2(a+b+c)) and replayed numerically (max deviation 8.9e-16). Hence max_s|Ts|_1>=(1/2)sum|Tij| and 3=tr(ST)<=(max|Sij|)(sum|Tij|) give lam>=3/2, extended to translated Pi by lemma. Prop.2: f=sum sqrt(xi^2+delta^2), delta=1e-6, C^inf with diag Hessian delta^2/(xi^2+delta^2)^{3/2}>0 so strictly convex; even, coercive, f(0)<1 so K is symmetric convex body; sandwich |x|_1<=f<=|x|_1+3delta gives (1-3delta)B1 subset K subset B1; grad!=0 on {f=1} gives C^inf hypersurface; strict convexity of f gives strictly convex body. Transfer: r=999997/1e6; K subset Q subset lam K => B1 subset r^{-1}Q subset (lam/r)B1 so lam>=(3/2)r=1.4999955>=1.1; integers 3*999997-2200000=799991>0 replayed. Product: monotonicity + polarity reversal (rB1 subset K subset B1 => K^circ subset r^{-1}B1^circ) gives P(K)<=(32/3)r^{-3}; inequality (32/3)r^{-3}<32/3+1e-3 equivalent to 32003*999997^3-32000*10^18=2711973864080135919>0 replayed exactly; excess <=9.6e-5. Thus K is C^inf (hence C^2) strictly convex symmetric with d_BM>=1.1 but P<32/3+1e-3, disproving target. Boundary cases (r>0, origin interior, translated Pi, strict convexity) all handled. Script output/artifacts/verify_counterexample.py prints VERIFY_OK (replayed). Distinguishes proof from experiment: core is proof with exact-integer certificates; random sampling only sanity replay for analytic identities.
